svg.aria-label: ZenLedger, 2017–23: Founding Engineer & Lead Software Engineer. Joined at MVP, scaled through a $15M Series B. Led a team of up to 15; rewrote the tax engine from Rails to Go: 70% less compute, 60% faster.
